statement: Split/merge mirror replay survives a source restart: a durable snapshot barrier index and replay watermark are persisted with the transition, queued deltas replay from the Raft log rather than the volatile in-memory array, the queue is bounded in the interim, and recovery starts-or-resumes the replication worker (reconstruction without resumption is not recovery). doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/durable-replay-cursor.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — persisted-watermark, raft-log-replay, bounded-queue, and worker-resumption receipts all passing.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Reconstructing execution state without starting or resuming the replication worker is NOT recovery: after any source restart mid-transition the after-write hooks must not return into silent non-mirroring (F6 + F10 combine into permanent divergence with no error and no log).

Queued deltas replay from the source partition's Raft log behind the persisted watermark, not from the volatile pendingEntries array; the RAM-only append must stop being the ack point (bounded queue with backpressure or durable enqueue until the cursor lands).
Each new regression test must fail when the corresponding cursor/replay/resumption mechanism is reverted while the rest of the change remains.

The oracle evidence files must be written by a deterministic evidence harness that re-runs the recorded proof commands (focused test files, red-on-revert checks) at quest terminal; no hand-authored metric values.
